headline: China's Moonshot AI Preps a 'Claude Killer' with Massive New Open-Source Model
reasoning: This topic scores highly due to its strong clickability within the current AI-obsessed news cycle and its relevance to the open-source vs. closed-source debate. While the specifics are slightly niche, the 'new challenger to OpenAI/Claude' angle has mainstream potential, and the story lends itself to numerous engaging formats like head-to-head comparisons and explainers on the future of AI development.
summary: Chinese AI lab Moonshot is reportedly releasing Kimi 3, a massive open-weight model with up to 3 trillion parameters, aiming to compete directly with top closed-source models from Anthropic and OpenAI.

source_articles.title: Moonshot’s upcoming Kimi 3 is expected to close the gap with Anthropic’s Opus 4.8
source_articles.excerpt: The FT reports Kimi K3 will be the largest open AI model from China, with a parameter count between 2 trillion and 3 trillion.
